name: Instrumented original mudcrab fresh creature inventory

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local done=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if done or core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 local crab=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6c927))
 if not crab or not crab:isValid() then return end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died in mudcrab baseline')
 local inventory=Actor.inventory(crab)
 for _,item in ipairs(inventory:getAll()) do
  local record=item.type.record and item.type.record(item)
  print('MudcrabLoot spawn item='..item.recordId..' count='..inventory:countOf(item.recordId)..' name='..(record and record.name or '?'))
 end
 print('MudcrabLoot spawn ready target='..tostring(crab)..' pos='..tostring(crab.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(crab).current..' playerHealth='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 done=true
end}}}}
